verdict.rationale: Vestd is UK-based and clearly supports UK-specific schemes like EMI (scheme setup and granting), CSOPs, growth shares, unapproved options, and SEIS/EIS advance assurance, which are the core 'non-US' UK HMRC-approved plan types. However, evidence is UK-centric only — there's no mention of other countries' option plans or valuations for international entities beyond the UK/US (409A) pairing, and no detail on how HMRC valuations are actually calculated/certified vs just scheme setup. missing for 10: evidence of valuation methodology/certification for HMRC-approved schemes, support for non-UK/non-US jurisdictions' option plans, and any documentation of multi-country entity handling.
